name: subsurface
purpose: Subsurface scattering (run with --subsurface PRESET [--subsurface-scale S]): a pale slab with a straight shadow edge under an overhead sun, seen from above, where the light spreads into the shadow (red farthest in skin), and a ball of 10 cm radius (a head's size) whose terminator softens. tools/cycles/subsurface.py fits the spread against Cycles'.
